notes.title: Trailer Release and Demo Announce!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone, this is GEARL MATRIX team.
We sincerely thank you for showing interest in our game and adding it to wish list! We are thrilled to announce that the trailer of "My evil magician boss suddenly loves me?!" has officially been released! Demo version will be available in the end of December! 
We hope you will check it out! 
Join us in social media to follow the news. Your feedback would be highly appreciated, since it's our first game.
Your support is our driving force to move forward!
